name: AzureIoTOperationsOPCUAConnector
description: Azure IoT Operations connector for OPC UA.

address.description: The address of the OPC UA server to connect with in the format: <tcp address>:<port>/<path>.

additionalConfigurationSchema.title: AIO OPC UA Device Inbound Endpoint Additional Configuration Schema
additionalConfigurationSchema.description: Schema for the additional configuration of OPC UA inbound endpoint of an device in Azure Industrial Operations

applicationName.description: Name that is used if AIO OPC UA Connector needs to create own (self-signed) certificate

keepAliveMilliseconds.description: Keep alive interval, to maintain session between OPC UA server and AIO OPC UA Connector

publishingIntervalMilliseconds.description: Default interval used to send value changes from OPC UA server to AIO OPC UA Connector

samplingIntervalMilliseconds.description: Default interval used to sample values of observed datapoints on the OPC UA server

queueSize.description: Default size of the queue that contains datapoint value changes on the OPC UA server

keyFrameCount.description: Default multiplier of the `publishing interval`, defines which value change should be a keyframe (contains all values, even if they haven't changed)

timeoutMilliseconds.description: Time after which the session is closed if there was no message from the OPC UA server

keepAliveIntervalMilliseconds.description: Keep alive interval, to maintain session between OPC UA server and AIO OPC UA Connector

reconnectPeriodMilliseconds.description: Default waiting time used in between session reconnects

reconnectExponentialBackOffMilliseconds.description: Exponential backoff time used during session reconnects

enableTracingHeaders.description: Send W3C tracing information along with OPC UA service calls

maxItems.description: Maximum number of datapoints/events added to one subscription

lifeTimeMilliseconds.description: Time after which the subscription is closed if there was no message from the OPC UA server

securityPolicy.description: Security policy used to establish secure channel with the OPC UA server

securityMode.description: Security mode used to communicate within secure channel with the OPC UA server

runAssetDiscovery.description: Automatically run OPC UA asset discovery every 10min

syncPropertiesIntoStateStore.description: Read properties of datapoints and write them into AIO MQTT Distributed State Store

shared.description: Whether the endpoint profile is shared across multiple connectors

datasetConfigurationSchema.title: AIO OPC UA Asset Dataset Additional Configuration Schema
datasetConfigurationSchema.description: Schema for the additional configuration of OPC UA asset dataset in Azure Industrial Operations

publishingInterval.description: Interval used to send value changes from OPC UA server to AIO OPC UA Connector - overwrites the default interval

samplingInterval.description: Interval used to sample values of observed datapoints on the OPC UA server - overwrites the default interval

queueSize.description: Size of the queue that contains datapoint value changes on the OPC UA server - overwrites the default size

keyFrameCount.description: Multiplier of the `publishing interval`, defines which value change should be a keyframe (contains all values, even if they haven't changed) - overwrites the default count

startInstance.description: Expanded node id of OPC UA node that defines root for browse path addressing

dataSource.description: OPC UA expanded node id or relative browse path, to identify the OPC UA variable node in the address space

dataPointConfigurationSchema.title: AIO OPC UA Asset Data-Point Additional Configuration Schema
dataPointConfigurationSchema.description: Schema for the additional configuration of OPC UA asset data-point in Azure Industrial Operations

samplingInterval.description: Interval used to sample values of observed datapoints on the OPC UA server - overwrites the dataset interval

queueSize.description: Size of the queue that contains datapoint value changes on the OPC UA server - overwrites the dataset size

eventGroupConfigurationSchema.title: AIO OPC UA Asset EventGroup Additional Configuration Schema
eventGroupConfigurationSchema.description: Schema for the additional configuration of OPC UA asset event group in Azure Industrial Operations

publishingInterval.description: Interval used to send value changes from OPC UA server to AIO OPC UA Connector - overwrites the default interval

samplingInterval.description: Interval used to evaluate event on the OPC UA server - overwrites the default interval

queueSize.description: Size of the queue that contains event notifications on the OPC UA server - overwrites the default size

conditionRefreshInterval.description: Interval used to request conditionRefresh2 on the OPC UA server for the selected event notifiers in this group

dataSource.description: Expanded Node Id of the source object whose EventNotifier attribute includes reporting bit

typeRef.description: Expanded Node Id of the OPC UA Node defining an EventType (used for filtering)

eventConfigurationSchema.title: AIO OPC UA Asset Event Additional Configuration Schema
eventConfigurationSchema.description: Schema for the additional configuration of OPC UA asset event in Azure Industrial Operations

samplingInterval.description: Interval used to evaluate event on the OPC UA server - overwrites the event group interval

queueSize.description: Size of the queue that contains event notifications on the OPC UA server - overwrites the event group size

startInstance.description: Expanded node id of OPC UA node that defines root for browse path addressing

eventFilter.description: Filter the events that should be send from the event notifier to the AIO OPC UA Connector

typeDefinitionId.description: Expanded node id of the event type that should be filtered for

fieldId.description: Name overwrite of an event field

conditionRefresh.description: If enabled, a ConditionRefresh2 is requested from the OPC UA server after subscription creation

targetUri.description: Expanded Node Id of the OPC UA Node that should be written (Variable Node) or called (MethodId)

typeRef.description: Expanded Node Id of the OPC UA Node (Object) that is used to call (ObjectId)
